description: Every criterion documented, but estimated value is above the auto-limit — must be HUMAN_REVIEW, not READY. Generalist sees 'complete' and says ready.

request.clinicalNote: Four-month history of left L5/S1 radiculopathy. Straight-leg raise positive at 35 degrees on the left with reduced ankle reflex and S1 sensory loss. Completed an eight-week supervised physiotherapy programme with a musculoskeletal physiotherapist and a full course of oral analgesia, both without lasting benefit. No red-flag features. MRI requested to confirm the level and decide between targeted injection and surgical referral, which will change management.

criteria.text: at least six weeks of completed physiotherapy
